points.point: For AI-server PCB, the VNA (R&S ZNA/ZNB) is mapped to insertion loss (IL) and TDR measurements.
points.label: covered
points.why: states ZNA/ZNB on server PCB for IL and TDR

points.point: On server motherboard/PCBA the ZNA is listed for high-speed trace test, alongside ZNL for PDN Target Z and FSWP for clock jitter/LDO NSD.
points.label: partial
points.why: covers ZNA high-speed trace and ZNL PDN Target Z, but omits FSWP clock jitter/LDO NSD

points.point: VNAs also cover connector/cable and GPU/CPU/IC interconnect characterization, including high-speed cable test with OSP switching and TDR on GPU.
points.label: partial
points.why: covers connector/cable high-speed test with OSP, but not GPU TDR or CPU/IC interconnect mapping clearly

points.point: The R&S PCB test workflow stages where these VNA measurements land are material measurement, stackup selection, SI modeling/testing, sampling testing and process monitoring.
points.label: covered
points.why: lists material measurement, stackup selection, SI testing, sampling and process monitoring

points.point: In the SerDes SI/PI test map, network analyzers are the instrument class for the Power Distribution Network block, while interface/link test uses scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices.
points.label: partial
points.why: states network analyzers for PDN, but does not clearly state interface/link test uses scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices

points.point: ZNA options supporting this workflow role include time-domain analysis (TDR), eye diagram, de-embedding and Delta-L PCB characterization.
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions TDR, eye diagram and de-embedding generally, but not as ZNA options and omits Delta-L

points.point: The VNA must be deployed as a total solution with probe, mount-kit and de-embedding tooling, and can be integrated into inline/ATE setups (4-port ZNB3044 + OSP320 + flying probe + interposer).
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions probe, mount-kit and de-embedding tooling, but not inline/ATE setup with ZNB3044, OSP320, flying probe and interposer

points.point: The mapping is a sales-lead level source: no formal test setup, option, fixture, frequency or calibration condition is provided.
points.label: covered
points.why: states mapping is sales-level, not a formal configuration guide, with no fixture or calibration details

invented: R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series up to 67 GHz
R&S ZNB3000 is a Vector Network Analyzer series with base frequency range up to 43.5 GHz and upgrade option to 54.0 GHz
R&S ZNL is a 2-port Vector Network Analyzer series up to 20 GHz
